References:   
Body:

Targeted follow-up training has been assigned to those who submitted credentials and is due within thirty days. The exercise is not used for performance purposes. Please direct questions to this office.

Correspondence should be addressed to this office rather than to individual staff.

References:   
Body:

Nothing further is required at this stage.

Scoring inputs this cycle are unchanged: filing history, disciplinary history, tips and complaints, assets and account growth, and time since the last examination. Please review your branch's allocation and flag any firm you believe the model has mis-scored before the list is locked. Let me know if anything looks off.

References:   
Body:  
For your records: The staff will conduct an examination of Pentreath Bowick Advisers under Section 204 of the Investment Advisers Act of 1940. The examination has been assigned number EX-2023-51010. Fieldwork is expected to begin in approximately four weeks and the initial document request list follows under separate cover. Please identify a primary contact for production questions and confirm that the firm's books and records for the review period are accessible in the form in which they are kept. Detail is in the attached schedule.

Body:  
One item on this: The staff will conduct an examination of Tarnbrook Iveson Capital under Section 204 of the Investment Advisers Act of 1940. The examination has been assigned number EX-2025-51010. The firm will report the assessment in its next annual updating amendment and will arrange an independent verification for any period in which the analysis is not free from doubt. Happy to walk through it.
